      Daily Oil Wash

      Nourishing oil wash

      Coming soon

      Orange Blossom Neroli

      Out of stock Orange Blossom Neroli is invigorating + bright

      Limited to 20 per customer

      Body wash goes luxe.

      A gentle body cleanser that provides a deeply nourishing wash, free from soap and sulfates. Its unique oil formula transforms into a milky lather when mixed with warm water, leaving the skin feeling soft and hydrated. Now available in two iconic scents.

      8.4 fl oz / 250 ml

      • Cleansing
      • Nourishing
      • Smoothing
      • Refreshing

      Dermatologist-tested, gynecologist-tested, cruelty-free, vegan + suitable for sensitive skin.
      Orange Blossom Neroli Daily Oil Wash is part of our original body collection—affectionately known as Body Hero.

      Two unique scents for a luxurious + transportative experience.

      • Top: Bergamot, Pear Water
      • Mid: Orange Flower, Neroli Buds
      • Dry: Fresh Cypress, Soft Musks
      • Top: Fig Leaf, Lavandin
      • Mid: Clary Sage, Geranium
      • Dry: Sandalwood, Coconut Milk

      Daily Oil Wash ingredients

      Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Isopropylamine Dodecylbenzenesulfonate, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Glyceryl Caprylate/Caprate, Fragrance/Parfum, Dimethyl Lauramide/Myristamide, Linalool, Glycine Soja (Soybean) Oil, Glycerin, Phytosterols, Tocopherol, Water/Aqua/Eau, Hexyl Cinnamal, Geraniol, Limonene, Citronellol.

      Daily Oil Wash leaves skin feeling soft and deeply hydrated.

      • 100% immediately agree skin looks and feels hydrated, nourished and smooth
      • 97% immediately agree skin looks and feels clean and supple
      • 94% immediately agree product creates a soft lather and feels luxurious

      Ingredients that gently cleanse skin, leaving it nourished and comfortable.

      A naturally-derived oil blend that gently cleanses, smooths and nourishes skin.

      A trustworthy hydrator that attracts and retains moisture.

      A natural antioxidant that supports the skin’s moisture barrier and helps defend it against free radicals.

      Daily Oil Wash ingredients

      Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Isopropylamine Dodecylbenzenesulfonate, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Glyceryl Caprylate/Caprate, Fragrance/Parfum, Dimethyl Lauramide/Myristamide, Linalool, Glycine Soja (Soybean) Oil, Glycerin, Phytosterols, Tocopherol, Water/Aqua/Eau, Hexyl Cinnamal, Geraniol, Limonene, Citronellol.

      Add a little luxe to your lather.

      1. In the shower, massage generously all over wet skin. The oil will emulsify into a soft, frothy lather as it cleanses.
      2. Don’t forget to take a moment for yourself and breathe that Orange Blossom blend in.
      3. Rinse thoroughly (while singing your favorite song, of course).
      4. gTEAM tip: Pump a little into running bath water for a fragrant bubble bath! Or, if you’re looking for an even deeper clean, you can pump a little product onto our Exfoliating Bar and
